title: Rubrik Appoints Amit Nehru to Lead Global System Integrators and Managed Service Provider Business
summary: ServiceNow Executive Joins Rubrik with a 25-year track record of strategic collaboration with GSIs, Technology Partnerships, and management consulting firms. Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK), the Security and AI Operations company, today announced the appointment of Amit Nehru as Group Vice President of GSIs and MSPs. Nehru will lead Rubrik's GSI business to accelerate cyber resilience through strategic global partnerships. Nehru’s appointment continues the growth momentum of Rubrik's partner ecosystem, following Rubrik’s new platform innovations designed to scale MSP-operated cyber resilience. With over 25 years of expertise in scaling global partnerships, Nehru joins Rubrik following a transformative tenure at ServiceNow. As Vice President of Global Partnerships and Channels, he sustained a 45% year-over-year growth rate for the Global Partners and MSP business over five consecutive years.
